title: One row of governance_build.run_records.run_record (A6)
description: Frozen in phase 001. One row as platform/runs/k2runs.py's record(conn, **row) passes it, written only by svc.runs; the table's DDL is platform/runs/run_record.sql. Append-only history and the drift check's reference: the audited tag, not this table, is authoritative (A6). Every column is present; a column that does not apply is null.

release_id.description: The release the run was pinned to (A1).

task.description: The task that wrote the row.

event.description: What happened. audited: the audited tag moved (dbt) or main fast-forwarded (bronze).

table_name.description: The table, fully qualified as the writer names it; null for a task-level row.

snapshot_before.description: The table's snapshot id saved before the step.

snapshot_after.description: The table's snapshot id after the step.

inputs.description: The inputs the run read, stored as JSON text in the varchar column.

relation.description: What the run read: k2gen.model.input_relation of the input.

snapshot.description: The audited snapshot id read; null when the input was never audited.

state.description: The input product's lifecycle state in the run's release; how late it was is lagMinutes.

lagMinutes.description: How far the input was behind, in minutes; null when unknown.

started_at.description: When the step started, UTC, timestamp(6) with time zone.

recorded_at.description: When the row was written, UTC; the table's partition source, day(recorded_at).

duration_s.description: How long the step took, in seconds.

detail.description: A message, at most 1,000 characters, cut as dbt/macros/record_test_results.sql cuts them.

dbt_invocation_id.description: dbt's invocation_id on a build row; the results hook writes the same id and the run_id on every test row, so a publish joins its tests. Null for a step dbt did not run.

openlineage_run_id.description: The OpenLineage run id the step emitted lineage under, a UUID; null while no lineage is emitted.
